QuestInfo.name: Nautilus' Secret Entree
QuestInfo.0: A foul odor has been reported in Nautilus. People say it's Tangyoon trying to cook up some strange dish like he did two years ago. Head there and investigate.
QuestInfo.1: You learned that Tangyoon is cooking up a secret entrée. Find him #b50 Green Mushroom Caps#k
QuestInfo.2: A foul odor has been reported in Nautilus. People say it's Tangyoon trying to cook up some strange dish like he did two years ago.

0.0: I knew if I stayed here too long my genius would go to waste! Seriously, a great chef like me needs inspiration! But nooo, all these seamen want are simple meals that are beneath someone of my expertise!
0.1: For two years now I've put up with this! No more! I'm working on a secret dish to blow the socks off of these people. And you know what? You're going to help me.

yes.0: This secret dish I'm working on is rather complicated. And no, I can't tell you what it is. Then it wouldn't be a secret, right? But I will tell you this much. The main ingredient is #bGreen Mushroom Caps.#k Yup, I said #bGreen Mushroom Cap#k. Could you grab me #b50 Green Mushroom Caps#k?

no.0: You don't want to be part of culinary history? Fine. There are other fish in the sea.
